resources.string: Remove all enrolled fingerprints before calibrating. Keep the device still on a table, then tap Start.
Calibration storage is not mounted. Calibration is disabled to protect the factory data in persist.
Place a flat, skin-coloured (or plain white) target over the circle, covering it completely, then tap Next.
Place a flat black target over the circle, covering it completely, then tap Next.
Place the chart target over the circle, then tap Next.
Step %1$s failed (error 0x%2$s). Tap Start to retry.
Step %1$s timed out. Tap Start to retry.
Calibration finished. Reboot the device before enrolling fingerprints.
